newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends quietly down, awaits data.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends quietly down, awaits data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed with extended losses as the market took its cue from a lower Chicago soyoil. Trading was cautious as the market lacked big players who awaited crop report from forecaster Ivan Wong. Activity was reduced. Dec futures will trade in 1.130 and 1,170 range in near-term.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Followed the futures market and interest was seen from refiners among selected products and nearby CPOs.
